name: Automation Workflows
headline: Basecamp Workflow Command: CLI Project Management
short_description: The Basecamp Workflow Command provides a comprehensive CLI tool for managing Basecamp projects, covering 155 endpoints. It's designed for developers and project managers looking to streamline their workflows in Basecamp.
author: basecamp

sections.overview:
The Basecamp Workflow Command provides complete CLI integration with Basecamp's project management features, including todos, cards, messages, files, schedule, check-ins, timeline, recordings, templates, webhooks, subscriptions, lineup, and campfire. It enables developers and project managers to automate and streamline Basecamp workflows directly from the command line. The skill requires the Basecamp CLI and an authenticated Basecamp account to function. Use it to manage projects programmatically, integrate Basecamp into development workflows, and reduce manual project management tasks.
Managing todos within Basecamp projects
Automating notifications and updates
Generating reports on project assignments
Parsing project URLs for API interaction
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/basecamp/skills --skill basecamp`
`git clone https://github.com/basecamp/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Basecamp Workflow Command script to [ACTION] in [COMPANY]'s Basecamp projects. Use the Basecamp CLI tool with the following parameters: [SPECIFIC_PARAMETERS]. Ensure the script handles errors gracefully and provides clear output.
```
